scope: Different-author, read-only source hammer of the sealed M1843 C2 fresh-mapped two-axis Formality and dual-corner PrimeTime source package. The review recomputed the M1832/M1834 failure chain, all source and authority seals, exact 13-row live RTL/filelist and both M1811 mapped axes, manually inspected Formality/PT and required report semantics, ran both source suites on CPython 3.6 and 3.12, and performed 71 synchronized-inventory mutations on both runtimes. No EDA, simulator, license query, attempt, result, release, canonical write, predecessor write, docs359 write, commit, or push was performed.
verdict: FAIL CLOSED. The exact M1843 runner currently contains the intended repairs: two live-RTL authority checks, complete M1844 review/manifest/outer release binding, and PT report/coverage/constraint parsing. However, its advertised static checker and 50-test suite reject many source mutations only because the source_inventory digest is stale. Once the inventory digest is synchronized, 14 of 71 independent mutations escape on both runtimes; eight are material gates involving the second live-authority check, attempt consumption, check_timing/coverage/constraint parsing, or truthful hold-slack publication. This is the same class of semantic false assurance that blocked M1831/M1833. M1844 therefore authorizes zero attempts and zero EDA runs.

findings.title: The 50-test static gate gives false semantic assurance when source inventory is updated consistently
findings.evidence: The independent hammer mutates runner/Formality/PT source and simultaneously updates the contract source_files SHA for the changed source. Fourteen of 71 mutations then pass C.check() on both CPython 3.6 and 3.12. Three only remove redundant required-list entries and three force later fail-safe exceptions, but eight materially weaken source authority or raw-result truthfulness: remove the second just-before-attempt verify_authority call, remove the write_attempt call, bypass unique check_timing success, bypass coverage conservation and required row-set checks, bypass machine constraint count validation and raw-violation visibility, or publish hold_wns_ns=0.0. The official tests do not synchronize source_files, so they report rejection at the inventory layer before exercising these semantics.
findings.impact: A future author can change a material runner/PT gate, update the declared source digest honestly, and still receive PASS_M1843_FORMAL_SOURCE_STATIC plus 50/50 tests. Exact M1843 bytes currently look correct, but the claimed checker/test authority is not independently robust enough to authorize the unique two-Formality/two-PT attempt.
findings.required_fix: Create an additive successor source identity. Its checker must explicitly bind the second pre-attempt authority call, the unique attempt-consumption call before tools, verify_formality/verify_pt result calls, check_timing uniqueness, coverage conservation and exact setup/hold/All Checks rows, machine constraint counts plus raw visibility, and verbatim setup/hold WNS writes. Its tests and independent hammer must synchronize source_files for each source mutation and reject all material attacks on both runtimes. Do not modify or reinterpret M1843/M1844.

required_next_gate: Additive successor source plus a different-author severity-zero synchronized-inventory hammer; only then may a new double-sealed release authorize one future attempt. M1843 and M1844 remain immutable failure evidence.
